content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign continues to roll out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual tweak, this time focusing on the look of conversation bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

A fresh, rounder look for conversation bubbles

After months of testing and refinement via TestFlight with select user groups, WhatsApp has finally rolled out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted signs of a conversation bubble redesign in the app's code. According to the site's latest report, the new bubble design has begun rolling out to some users via the latest TestFlight build.

The following is quoted from WABetaInfo's report:

Beyond the change in message bubble shape, the new design also adjusts how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green border around media and links, giving photos, videos, animated GIFs and link previews a cleaner, more unified look.

According to WABetaInfo, the new design is currently available only to a small number of WhatsApp TestFlight users, and there's no confirmed timeline for a wider rollout to all iOS users.
